data_description.llm_provider: Picking a provider fills in its OpenAI-compatible base URL. The URL stays editable, for a local router or reverse proxy.
data_description.llm_reasoning_effort: Lower effort cuts cost while keeping reasoning intact. Use Reasoning mode to turn it off entirely, but note that disabling it makes multi-step tasks fail.

data_description.llm_provider: Picking a provider fills in its OpenAI-compatible base URL. The URL stays editable, for a local router or reverse proxy.
data_description.scene_labels: One per line as `name: definition`, with a half-width colon (not the full-width `：` that a Chinese IME types by default). Leave empty to use the built-in set. Always give a definition: without one the model can only guess, and abstention rose from 11% to 55% when definitions were missing.
data_description.prompt_override: Leave empty to use the built-in judgement rules. The output contract and the scene description are still appended automatically, because both the parser and the rules depend on them.
data_description.person_highlight: Appends a magnified column of the person to the right of the evidence sheet, so clothing and carried items can be made out. Adds a little cost.
data_description.face_service_url: An OpenCV face-detection service used to choose which frame the close-up shows, e.g. http://192.168.166.50:8788. Leave empty to disable it and pick by largest detection box only, exactly as before. An unreachable or slow service falls back to the same rule.

vision_not_configured.title: Vision provider not configured
vision_not_configured.description: Entry {entry_id} has no vision provider settings, so activities are never analysed.

provider_unavailable.title: Vision provider unreachable
provider_unavailable.description: Entry {entry_id} cannot reach the configured vision provider.

provider_error.title: Vision provider is answering with errors
provider_error.description: Entry {entry_id} received an error from the vision provider (5xx, or 429 quota exhausted), so activities are not being analysed and no notifications are sent for them. A 5xx is usually an overloaded or briefly unavailable provider, and was already retried automatically; a 429 means the quota is spent and needs the window to reset or a plan change, and is not retried automatically. Check the 'Last error' sensor for the exact status, and use the 'frigate_vision.retry_failed' service once the provider recovers.

storage_corrupt.title: Stored state invalid
storage_corrupt.description: Entry {entry_id} stopped to protect persisted state.

media_cleanup_failed.title: Media cleanup failed
media_cleanup_failed.description: Entry {entry_id} could not clean an evidence file.

delivery_outcome_unknown.title: Delivery outcome unknown
delivery_outcome_unknown.description: Entry {entry_id} will not resend the notification.
